scope: Read-only preparation audit of seven operational helpers, seven README rows against exact owners and six source-issue texts; isolated mocked replay reproduction. No real helper/GitHub execution or science re-review of own borates.

findings.description: Aggregate output is reserved only after six external creates. Reusing the fixed precreation inventory after a prior completed run passes title checks and creates duplicates before aggregate open(x) rejects. A concurrent invocation has the same missing exclusive reservation.

reproduction.scope: Full exact helper executed only with pathlib base redirected to unique temporary directory and all subprocess.run calls mocked; occupied aggregate receipt represents a prior completed run.

findings.correction: Reserve the aggregate receipt exclusively before any GitHub mutation; retain terminal failure and all known mutation results in that reserved output; test occupied regular/symlink/dangling, rerun, successful creation and partial failure without real network calls.

other_assessments: Seven README summaries match maintained owner scope: synthetic crystals are explicit for uranium species; inyoite pressure and szaibelyite thermal contexts remain abiotic; Ce/La natural identity does not convert synthetic experiments into natural specimens; electrolyte product and capacity outcomes remain separate.

Six issue texts accurately describe existing retained source ambiguities and ask for attributable evidence; they do not label these as uncorrected owner defects or authorize author contact. This audit verifies electrolyte/uranium wording against records, not a new independent primary-science assessment.

Final gates use correct worktree/base, explicit offline environment,508-record hash inventory, sequential actual exit codes, exclusive log and receipt creation, and unchanged-input checks. The native checker reserves its output/log before running and does not certify exact record coverage by itself.

Review-bases helper enumerates native bundles including hidden/ignored/followed entries, checks ancestry and annotated tag identity; the specific historical tag is checked remotely. Final actual inventory must confirm no other nonancestor tag needs remote verification. No availability PASS is inferred before execution.

Integration collector replays inspected read-only command vectors, captures current rules/admission/issues/shepherd runs and governed sync check. Installed configuration is not represented as proof of shepherd execution.
Preservation checker verifies main branch/base/status plus baseline nontracked bytes/modes/symlink targets. This is bounded original-entry preservation, not deletion of unrelated files.
limitations: Batch gates were still running when this audit began; terminal success is not inferred here.
No hosted PR/CI/queue/merge/cleanup outcome was assessed.
No project owner, history, issue or helper was changed during this initial audit. The isolated reproduction mocked every subprocess call and wrote only a unique temporary directory.
